name: UniWalkVR
summary: UniWalkVR is a virtual reality application that recreates the university’s main campus as a virtual tour. It is based on the original web-based application, UniWalk, developed by the university’s GamesLab. The application enables prospective students and visitors to explore the campus virtually and gain an insight into what studying on campus might be like. This is particularly valuable for international applicants, as it offers a way to familiarise themselves with the university without the need for length
